title: Nouns and gender
summary: Learn nouns with ο, η, and το.

title: Definite and indefinite articles
summary: Use singular forms for the, a, and an.

title: Greetings
summary: Say hello, ask how someone is, and say goodbye.

title: Present tense: three common verbs
summary: Explore present-tense forms, questions, and negatives.

title: Accusative
summary: Learn the forms used for direct objects.

title: Plurals
summary: Talk about more than one person or thing.

title: Numbers
summary: Count from one to twenty and use numbers with nouns.

title: Food and drink
summary: Learn food and drink vocabulary with τρώω and θέλω.

title: Possessives: my and your
summary: Use μου and σου with family words and familiar nouns.

title: Adjectives
summary: Match common adjectives to singular and plural nouns.

title: Numbers 21–100
summary: Build numbers up to one hundred and combine tens and units.

title: Where are you from?
summary: Use είμαι and από with country names.

title: Where are you going?
summary: Use πάω and σε to talk about destinations and locations.

title: At home: furniture and rooms
summary: Name rooms and furniture and say where things are.
